judge.summary: The AI handled the investment question honestly and did not turn the buyer’s request for figures into a premature viewing push. Both support requests remained AI-owned and active, and the AI resumed with customer-facing answers that used the verified maintenance, supply, and absence of substantiated rental evidence in context. The second support result did not provide current pricing, so the AI correctly avoided presenting base references as all-in prices. The buyer explicitly declined a viewing and never reached appointment readiness; no formal handoff was appropriate. The main weaknesses were not retrieving the current-package source, omitting the maintenance source caveat, and becoming repetitive after the buyer asked to wait for verified figures.
judge.improvement_recommendation: For current effective-price questions, retrieve knowledge/project/pearlmont/02_commercial/sales-package.md alongside pricing.md, then clearly distinguish sourced base references from verified current net pricing. Keep the honest limits on yield and appreciation, add the maintenance source caveat, and use one relevant follow-up about holding horizon or target return rather than repeating that figures are unavailable. Do not propose an appointment while the buyer has explicitly declined one.
